items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: And people that were promoting that asked for Duke Ellington and Count Basie, I mean Duke Ellington, and the Cuttombs Band to play together.

ctx.x: I went to, what was it, my first time?

Oh, sure. I know we went up, went over to Europe. We went around near Belgium, went to England, and we went somewhere in Italy. Somewhere in Belgium was like a big place. You know, one place was behind the Iron Curtain, or something like that. But the woman that sang, was singing with Duke Ellington. She requested to sing Coastal Walk with us. And people that were promoting that asked for Duke Ellington and Count Basie, I mean Duke Ellington, and the Cuttombs Band to play together. And I was honored when Duke…
Then he had his fast song. He'd never miss it.
